findings.summary: Synchronous resetApiState on logout while ShellMenu keeps useGetMembershipQuery subscribed — timing change with a live competing actor.
findings.detail: R1 interaction replay: trigger onLogout dispatches shellApi.util.resetApiState() synchronously then auth/clear; route/shell ShellMenu stays mounted; active subscription useGetMembershipQuery({ userId }) remains a live probe subscriber; after cache reset that probe can refetch and fulfill into shared auth writers; user-visible outcome is cleared session then possible rewrite of auth/org from the still-mounted shell. Diff changes when reset runs (sync timing) without unmounting or deferring competing subscribers.
findings.replay_brief: onLogout sync resetApiState → ShellMenu still mounted → useGetMembershipQuery probe subscriber live → probe fulfill may write auth → session cleared then clobbered / rehydrated
findings.sibling: R2: membership probe must not share fulfill→write path with session writers after reset. R3: force-include ShellMenu as unchanged-looking shell across logout. R5: auth/clear vs probe refetch are dual sources of truth. R6: no competing-actor regression with an active subscription across resetApiState. R7 coverage: interaction_replay: auth; auth_flow_walk: logout.

notes: Opened kit L1 interaction-replay-checklist.md (R1–R7) plus auth-rtk-checklist.md and graphify-r3-force-include.md. Profile strict allowed L2 but vercel-react-best-practices was not installed (l2_loaded=false; skill_missing). Fixture logout.js calls resetApiState synchronously while ShellMenu keeps the membership probe subscriber live — classic side-effect × live actor miss. R4 n/a (no filter-in-menu / host focus). Prefer defer reset until shell probes unsubscribe, or keep probes read-only after reset, plus a competing-actor test with ShellMenu mounted across logout timing.
